answer.note: The writer is `write()` in dogwhistle/study.py (A), lines 54-68. It refuses an existing path with FileExistsError, writes JSON to a mkstemp temp file, optionally calls fchmod 0o600 when private=True, and then does os.replace. The check-then-replace is not atomic, so there is a race, and os.replace would overwrite a file created in that window. The sibling `checkpoint()` overwrites on purpose, so it is not the answer. All four ref files contain identical generic text and give no file-specific priority, so the choice of two refs is mine. B (heldout.py) is the second pick, an arbitrary choice among B, C and D, which look near-identical in structure. My grep found no writer implementation in B, C or D. They only call exists() checks, so they presumably use study's write, but I didn't confirm that. Proposed 60 minutes: study.py 40 (read write(), then check its race and cleanup behavior), heldout.py 10, visibility.py 5, honest.py 5 (call-site checks only). Note that listener.py:152 has a similar encrypted writer, but it is outside the candidate list and has an overwrite flag.

54	def write(path: Path, value: Any, *, private: bool = False) -> None:
55	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
56	    if path.exists():
57	        raise FileExistsError(path)
58	    payload = json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n"
59	    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f".{path.name}.", dir=path.parent)
60	    try:
61	        if private:
62	            os.fchmod(fd, 0o600)
63	        with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
64	            stream.write(payload)
65	        os.replace(temporary, path)
66	    finally:
67	        if os.path.exists(temporary):
68	            os.unlink(temporary)

71	def checkpoint(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
72	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
73	    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f".{path.name}.", dir=path.parent)
74	    try:
75	        os.fchmod(fd, 0o600)
76	        with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
77	            json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False)
78	            stream.write("\n")
79	        os.replace(temporary, path)
80	    finally:
81	        if os.path.exists(temporary):
